description: Reposition Changes panel to be a first-class citizen in IssueDetailPage, visible in all stages with summary statistics

tasks.title: Reposition and ungate Changes panel in IssueDetailPage
tasks.description: In IssueDetailPage.tsx: remove the DIFF_STAGES constant and the `showDiff` guard (line 25, 265). Move the Changes panel JSX block (lines 417-524) from after Comments to after Description, before TaskList. Replace the early-return null (line 420) with an empty state ('No changes yet') so the panel renders in all stages. Add a summary statistics line above the Files/Commits tabs showing file count, +/- line totals, and commit count, computed from diffData.files and commitsData.commits.
acceptanceCriteria: No stage-based conditional wraps the Changes panel render block
Changes panel JSX appears between Description and TaskList in source order
No Changes/Diff section appears after Comments in main content column
Summary line shows N files, +X/-Y totals, M commits when data exists
Panel shows 'No changes yet' empty state when no files and no commits
Existing Files/Commits tabs and expandable diff viewer still work unchanged
Build passes (cd packages/cli && npm run build)
tasks.notes: All changes are in a single file. No API or hook changes needed — useIssueDiff and useIssueCommits already fetch unconditionally.
